content.title: National Burrito Day 2026: Here’s how to get free and discounted burritos
content.text: SavorNation is reader-supported and may earn an affiliate commission. (SavorNation) — National Burrito Day is Thursday, and restaurants nationwide are celebrating with burrito BOGOs and discounts. Burritos have become deeply embedded in American food culture. From cafes selling quick, on-the-go egg-filled burritos to chefs getting creative with fusion concepts (sushi-burritos, bulgogi-filled burritos, etc.), the dish has become a commonplace meal. Therefore, it might be a surprise that the burrito is a relatively new food concept, likely invented in Northern Mexico in the 1910s or 1920s. Unlike tacos, burritos are made with wheat tortillas, which are more pliable and better hold the filling. However, it wasn’t until the 1960s when the burrito truly made its mark on the U.S. food scene with the invention of San Francisco’s Mission Burrito, a style characterized by its massive size, abundance of toppings and foil wrapping. Here are Amazon’s bestsellers in kitchen and dining this week When is National Burrito Day? While it’s not clear when the first National Burrito Day emerged, the food holiday is now annually celebrated on the first Thursday of April. Many restaurants offer burrito deals in celebration, so we’ve rounded up a list of 15 epic BOGOs and discounts you can get on April 2. National Burrito Day free burritos and discounted deals California Tortilla The East Coast chain is celebrating National Burrito Day with a $10 reward. Buy any burrito on Thursday and receive a $10 reward to use for a future visit. Chronic Tacos The California-based Mexican chain is giving loyalty members a buy-one-get-one-free burrito deal via the Chronic Tacos app on Thursday. Del Taco Place an order of at least $3 through Del Taco’s rewards app or website and receive a free classic burrito on Thursday. Dog Haus (Courtesy: Dog Haus) The California-based gourmet hot dog chain is giving its rewards members a $3 Haus Burrito (three sunny-side-up eggs, smoked bacon, white American cheese, crispy tater tots, caramelized onions and spicy mayo, wrapped in a flour tortilla and grilled) on Thursday. All proceeds from the $3 Haus Burrito will be donated to No Kid Hungry, a national campaign dedicated to ending childhood hunger nationwide. Anyone who redeems the $3 burrito will automatically receive a BOGO reward for Dog Haus’ Bad-A** Breakfast Burritos, valid through April 30. El Pollo Loco (Courtesy: El Pollo Loco) El Pollo Loco is offering a buy one, get one free deal on burritos at all store locations on Thursday. Farmer Boys (Courtesy: Farmer Boys) Farmer Boys rewards members (known as VIF, or Very important Farmer) can buy a breakfast burrito for half price with the purchase of another at regular price via the Farmer Boys app on Thursday. Chipotle Participating Chipotle locations in the U.S. and Canada are offering free delivery on orders placed through the app or website for customers who use the promo code “DELIVER.” Orders must total a minimum of $10. Other terms and conditions may apply. Hot Head Burritos (Courtesy: Hot Head Burritos) The Midwestern chain is giving its rewards members a free burrito through an online BOGO deal on Thursday. Huddle House Huddle House is offering buy one, get one 50% off MVP Burrito Meals for rewards members on Thursday. Moe’s Southwest Grill (Courtesy: Moe’s Southwest Grill) Moe’s is celebrating National Burrito Day with a BOGO deal on burritos, bowls and Moe Value Meals all day in-store. Burrito budget busted? Chipotle confirms 2026 price hikes Rewards members get extra perks: access to the BOGO deals starting Tuesday, and an automatic sweepstakes entry to win free burritos for a year with any purchase on Thursday. One hundred winners will be alerted via push notification. Rubio’s (Courtesy: Rubio’s) Use code BURRITO on Thursday to drop the price of any burrito (including chips and salsa) to $7.99. Offer redeemable in-restaurant, online or in-app. Surcheros Fresh Mex The restaurant chain is giving rewards members the chance to redeem a burrito for half price when purchasing another at regular price. The deal is valid Thursday, redeemable in-restaurant, online or in-app. Taco Cabana Taco Cabana rewards members can get 25% off any order with the purchase of a burrito on Thursday. Taco John’s (Courtesy: Taco John’s) Taco John’s rewards members can redeem a free bean burrito with a minimum $3 purchase via the Taco John’s app on Thursday. Tijuana Flats Tijuana Flats is offering a free “Make It Wet” upgrade on any burrito purchased Thursday. Tocaya (Courtesy: Tocaya) The California-based Mexican chain is giving rewards members a free side of chips and guacamole with the purchase of any burrito on Thursday.
